item.title: Medic having meal near Krakow attack credited with saving officer
item.description: A medical professional eating near the scene of a shooting close to Krakow likely kept an officer alive, a peer stated. New information has surfaced about two officers praised for stopping a gunman from harming more people.

item.title: Salman F Rahman may engage foreign lawyer as observer: Prosecutor
item.description: Prosecutor Gazi Monowar stated that Salman F Rahman, an accused in crimes against humanity during the July mass uprising and former adviser to ex-prime minister Sheikh Hasina, can appoint a foreign lawyer as an observer.

item.title: FA Cup Opening Round Highlights Presented by Jason Mohammad
item.description: Jason Mohammad hosts the television broadcast showing key moments and action sequences from the opening stage of the FA Cup competition.

item.title: Authorities uncover major arms smuggling ring across three Indian states
item.description: Special task forces from Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Haryana conducted joint raids revealing a vast weapons trafficking network. Operatives seized 44,000 rounds of ammunition and arrested several suspects during the operation.

item.title: Eisenkot receptive to Netanyahu participating in upcoming cabinet
item.description: The Israeli president formally mandates the opposition chief to establish a fresh administration. Meanwhile, Eisenkot indicated he is open to including Netanyahu in the future government.

item.title: Alonso’s Chelsea struggles to find form following Sunderland loss
item.description: Chelsea continues to lack a clear style under Xabi Alonso, whose frustration was visible after a 1-0 loss to Sunderland. The team remains in search of its true identity.

item.title: Eisenkot accepts mandate to form government and opens doors
item.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog officially tasked opposition alliance leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government, ending Benjamin Netanyahu's tenure. Upon receiving the assignment on Sunday, Eisenkot stated that doors are open to everyone.

item.title: Shah Sanaul Huq's 'Protimbimbita Kabita' explores dual perspectives
item.description: Poet Shah Sanaul Huq's book features paired poems that reflect identical moments differently rather than mirroring them. These distinct works stem from the same source yet use unique language and imagery.

item.title: Lisa Nandy rejects repeating EU debates while supporting stronger relations
item.description: Cabinet minister Lisa Nandy stated a desire to sidestep endless debates regarding UK reentry into the European Union. However, she noted that strengthening ties could help deliver on initial referendum commitments.

item.title: Kozo Tashima aims to challenge Gianni Infantino for FIFA presidency
item.description: Japanese challenger Kozo Tashima expressed confidence in his ability to defeat incumbent Gianni Infantino, estimating his chance of success in the upcoming FIFA presidential election at up to thirty percent.

item.title: শ্রীলঙ্কার কোচের সাফ টুর্নামেন্ট ও রেফারি নিয়ে অসন্তোষ
item.description: সাফ টুর্নামেন্টে স্বাগতিক ও ভারতকে পক্ষপাত প্রদর্শনের অভিযোগ তুলেছেন শ্রীলঙ্কার কোচ। ভুটান ম্যাচের কয়েকটি রেফারিদের সিদ্ধান্ত নিয়ে প্রশ্ন তুলে তিনি এই টুর্নামেন্টের আয়োজন নিয়ে তীব্র সমালোচনা করেছেন।

item.title: Saturday Night Live introduces a fresh parody sketch targeting Elon Musk
item.description: The comedy program Saturday Night Live recently debuted a new comedic portrayal of technology executive Elon Musk, characterizing him harshly.

item.title: আড়াইহাজারে বিএনপির দুই পক্ষের সংঘর্ষে আহত ১০
item.description: নারায়ণগঞ্জের আড়াইহাজারে বিপ্লব ও সংহতি দিবসের কর্মসূচি শেষে ফেরার পথে বিএনপির দুটি দলের সংঘর্ষে অন্তত ১০ জন আহত হন। এদের মধ্যে দুজনকে উন্নত চিকিৎসার জন্য ঢাকা মেডিকেল কলেজ হাসপাতালে স্থানান্তর করা হয়েছে।

item.title: England secures a decisive victory against Australia at Allianz Stadium
item.description: England's rugby squad alleviated pressure on head coach Steve Borthwick by defeating Australia convincingly. The team delivered a strong performance at Allianz Stadium, scoring seven tries.

item.title: পোশাকশ্রমিকদের তিন বছরে ক্রয়ক্ষমতা এক তৃতীয়াংশ হ্রাস পেয়েছে
item.description: উচ্চ মূল্যস্ফীতির কারণে গত তিন বছরে তৈরি পোশাক খাতের শ্রমিকদের প্রকৃত ক্রয়ক্ষমতা প্রায় ২৯ শতাংশ কমে গেছে। ফলে সাড়ে ১২ হাজার টাকা ন্যূনতম মজুরিতে আগের সমপরিমাণ পণ্য কিনতে শ্রমিকের অতিরিক্ত অর্থ ব্যয় হচ্ছে।

item.title: শব্দ ও অক্ষরের নান্দনিক কাব্যিক মানচিত্র
item.description: কবিতা সৃষ্টির প্রক্রিয়ায় শব্দের সাথে নিরন্তর বসবাস ও অস্থির অক্ষরগুলোকে শৃঙ্খলিত করার প্রয়াসের কথা বলা হয়েছে। নানা বিন্যাস ও শব্দের অভিঘাতে এক পরিবর্তনশীল দৃশ্যপট এবং নতুন পরিচয়ের মানচিত্র ফুটিয়ে তোলা হয়েছে।

item.title: Egypt Train Crash Leaves Seven Dead and Over 100 Hurt
item.description: An accident involving two trains moving parallel near Giza caused multiple passenger cars to jump the tracks. The collision resulted in seven fatalities and injured upwards of 100 individuals.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz Claims Paris Masters Title by Defeating Shelton
item.description: Following a successful recovery from physical setbacks, Carlos Alcaraz overcame Ben Shelton to secure the Paris Masters championship. This victory marks another milestone in the Spanish tennis player's ongoing return.

item.title: Massive Amsterdam Demonstration Demands Action Against Israel
item.description: A large crowd gathered in Amsterdam for the 'Red Line' demonstration to oppose Israel's actions. Participants demanded a cessation of weapon shipments and more stringent commercial sanctions.

item.title: নেত্রকোনায় বিদ্যুৎ সংযোগ ফিরে পেলেন গ্রাহক স্বপন মিয়া

item.title: Apple Introduces Maxed-Out MacBook Pro Priced at $15,000

item.title: Marc Marquez Finishes Second in Qatar, Delaying Eighth Title

item.description: পুলিশের অপরাধ তদন্ত বিভাগের (সিআইডি) মূল কার্যালয়ের ভেতর এবং পল্লবী থানার মূল গেটের সামনে ককটেল বিস্ফোরণের ঘটনা ঘটেছে। এতে এলাকায় চাঞ্চল্যের সৃষ্টি হয়।

item.title: Manchester United Defeats Aston Villa Through Olme Goal

item.title: UK to Maintain AI Facility Growth
item.description: British officials confirmed that artificial intelligence data centers will proceed as vital public works, resisting any calls to decelerate development.

item.title: Arsenal Defeats Liverpool at Anfield
item.description: Alessia Russo netted twice to secure a 2-1 victory for Arsenal against Liverpool at Anfield, lifting her club to seventh in the Women's Super League standings.

item.title: Train Crash South of Cairo Leaves Seven Dead
item.description: At least seven individuals died and over 100 sustained injuries after two trains collided and derailed on Sunday in al-Ayyat, roughly 30 miles from Cairo. Egypt's president called for an immediate inquiry into the deadly incident.

item.title: Stockport Overcomes Cray in FA Cup Extra Time
item.description: Despite being reduced to ten men, League One team Stockport County overcame a deficit to defeat Isthmian League club Cray Wanderers 3-2 after extra time during the opening round of the FA Cup.

item.title: Integrating Multi-Brand Smart Home Gadgets
item.description: Combining smart home products from various manufacturers can be complicated, though several methods exist to ensure proper device communication.

item.title: Ex-Secret Service Agent Launches Cyber VC Fund
item.description: Former Secret Service investigator and Home Depot security chief Stephen Ward is organizing a second $250 million investment fund for Brightmind Partners following a personal legal battle.

item.title: Swapno Niye Foundation Honored for Social Work
item.description: The volunteer organization Swapno Niye Foundation received an award for its humanitarian and social welfare efforts during an event titled Pink Wellbeing: A Journey of Breast Cancer, held last Friday at the Renaissance Dhaka Gulshan Hotel.

item.title: School Bus Torched in Dhaka's Bhatara Area
item.description: A stationary school bus parked along the road in the Bhatara neighborhood of the capital was set on fire on November 8 at approximately six in the evening.

item.title: Grimsby Town Overcomes Stafford Rangers in FA Cup Thriller
